title: p -Values as QWERTY: Curating Evidence in the Computational Era

package_source.dataset_title: Replication Data for: p-values as QWERTY: Curating Evidence in the Computational Era

eligible_reason: Commentary on McShane et al. (2024), not an empirical DiD paper. The package illustrates estimation and uncertainty quantification with a cross-sectional GLM/GAM, a Stan model, a non-pooled analysis and a simulation; no panel, no treatment timing.
design_notes: Five R files: McShaneNLP.R (glm YesNo ~ NLPvar and mgcv gam with binomial family on a small illustrative dataset), McShaneStan.R (rstan), McShaneNonPooled.R, McShaneSimulation.R. McShaneNLPData.Rdata is 2.4 KB.
screener_notes: Ruled out from the abstract (Crossref) and the code: commentary, no DiD. main_text_unverified is false because no table placement question arises.
main_text_note: Commentary (JM 88(3), 20-28). No DiD terms, no fixed-effects panel in the text.
